page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m2.large is a burstable, budget-oriented virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads. It includes 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per core, and does not bundle any local storage or GPUs.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the lower tiers. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1300.19, and the multi-core score is 2402.69, both falling into the bottom 25% category. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 186.46 GB/sec, but this drops to a poor 20.68 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 1045.0 and a multi-core score of 1850.0, reflecting limited processing capacity under sustained workloads.

The burstable CPU allocation model means this instance is designed for workloads with low baseline CPU utilization that require occasional bursts. The lack of local storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps are significant tradeoffs. However, its resource density offers high qualitative cost efficiency for lightweight applications. It is suitable for low-traffic static web serving, basic Redis caching, development environments, and minor background tasks rather than resource-intensive database operations or data science jobs.
